losses.comment: From 10:41 to 11:44 PKT the market climbed from 1.1530 to 1.1545 in clean higher lows. The camel turned RED x1 only on the two-candle drop at 12:05-12:06 (1.15424 to 1.15365, 176 and 143 ticks). The 12:07-12:10 bounce printed the green UHV (12:09, 110 ticks, H 1.15406 / L 1.15381). The sell fired on its low at 1.15380, only 1.6 pips above the fresh 12:06/12:07 double low (1.15365/1.15368), with 60 ticks already traded in the breakout minute. The 1-pip target needed the bid near 1.1537, right into that double low. Buyers defended it and the 90-minute uptrend resumed. Twin 0407-070500-S sold the same first red hump 6 minutes earlier, from the top of the drop (box 18), and won. Twin 0407-100924-S sold inside a mature RED x4 trend. What I can see (first red hump against a 90-minute uptrend, sell 1.6 pips above a fresh double low) is common among winners: near_fresh_extreme x0.91, counter_trend60 x0.86. Not avoidable with anything measurable.

After the 11:44 top (1.1708) price fell to 1.1679 (12:13), then recovered in higher lows. At 12:46, 12:52 and 12:54 PKT it printed highs of 1.16996, 1.16997 and 1.17000: a triple top sitting on the 1.1700 big figure. The red UHV (12:55, 161 ticks, high 1.16990) triggered the buy at ask 1.16999, so the take-profit (bid 1.17000) was exactly that triple-top high and round number. The bid never printed 1.17000 and price slid 20 pips. Twin 0408-075005-B bought 3 pips below the ceiling (level 1.16970) and had room. Twin 0408-064551-B bought 2 pips under the 1.1708 double top and only just won. Visible before entry: the 100-pip figure sat 1.0 pip beyond the level. bigfig_ahead10 removes it (x2.34 train / x4.66 test, 7 losers), but that rule is fragile. It is selective only at the 1.0-pip threshold, this level sits exactly on that edge (float32 level), and beyond the session rules it drops to x1.90/x1.83.
losses.cause: into support/resistance (triple top at the 1.1700 big figure)

losses.comment: A 90-minute grind lower (1.1667 to 1.1654, four red humps, ADX 52) ended with a steep 9-pip leg from 11:13 to 11:26 to 1.16541. The first bounce candle (11:27, green, 86 ticks) became the UHV, and the sell broke its low at 1.16553, 1.2 pips above the fresh low. That is selling the fourth leg of an old trend at its extreme, and price reversed 13 pips within 30 minutes. The twins were quiet Asian-range sells (box 16 and box 20) and won. Across all trades this exhaustion profile wins at the base rate: the exhaustion rule (ADX >= 40, 60-bar move >= 3 ATR with the trade, level in the bottom quarter of the 60-bar range) is x1.72 on train and x0.78 on test. Not avoidable with what I measured.

Price ranged at 1.1673-1.1679 for 90 minutes. Then one red candle at 16:00 PKT (160 ticks, the loudest of the session) stabbed to 1.16695, below the range floor. The 16:01 green candle answered with 139 ticks (the UHV), and the sell broke its low at 1.16714, 2 pips above the stab. That is a spring or stop-run: the loudest selling candle could not hold new lows and met almost equal buying (ADX 70 from the spike). Price rallied 13 pips to 1.1683. Both twins sold the first lower high after an 18:38 top, not a fresh low. On the chart a skilled reader distrusts this sell, but the data does not confirm selling the fresh low after a spike: exhaustion x1.72/x0.78, near_fresh_extreme x0.91.

A 90-minute range at 1.1710-1.1718. Its floor near 1.1710 held at 16:40, 17:04, 17:11 and 17:24 PKT (low 1.17093). Two green candles off the 17:24 low formed the UHV (17:27, 93 ticks), and the sell broke it at 1.17108 with 80 ticks already in the breakout minute. That was the fourth test of the floor, and 90 seconds before the 12:30 UTC US data slot (Friday 10 April). From 17:29 to 17:35 price spiked up 15 pips. Twin 0410-122231-S sold the first break of the same floor 6 minutes earlier (box 20) and won before the spike. An economic calendar would have flagged this; the bars cannot. 12:25-12:35 UTC windows are not selective over all days (x0.84 train / x1.91 test, because most days have no release), and repeated floor tests are flat (retest_floor x1.06/x0.99).
losses.cause: news/spike (12:30 UTC release) into a range floor

losses.comment: Price slid from the 11:08 high (1.1695), then broke hard from 11:35 to 11:45: 12 pips down on rising volume (180 ticks at 11:44) to 1.16775. Two tiny candles at the low and the 11:46-11:47 green candles (UHV 122 ticks) came before the sell at 1.16782, under 1 pip above the capitulation low. Price V-reversed to 1.1692. Twin 0413-060302-S sold a quiet range; twin 0413-074313-S sold the first pullback from a top. Same verdict as 0409-062811-S: the climax-low profile (ADX 53, 60-bar move 4.3 ATR, level at the 60-bar low) is not selective (exhaustion x0.78 on test).

An 18-pip decline from the 16:38 top (1.1699) reached 1.1681 at 17:00 on swelling volume (220 ticks). A 17:02 spike back to 1.1687 was sold down to 1.16803 at 17:06, a marginal new low. The green 17:07-17:08 candles (UHV 150 ticks) then gave this sell at 1.16825, 2.2 pips above the double bottom (1.1681/1.1680). Twin 0413-120523-S sold the same decline at 17:05 (1.16819) and won, because the 17:06 marginal new low paid its pip. The second sell into the same floor had no new low left, and price rose to 1.1690. A second attempt into a fresh double bottom does not measure as selective: retest_floor x1.06/x0.99, near_fresh_extreme x0.91.

A 13-pip rally from 21:56 to 22:20 PKT (1.1724 to 1.1737) was followed by an hour-long flat flag at 1.1733-1.1738 (ADX 13.6, ATR 0.95 pip). The RED x2 camel came from 1-3-pip noise humps inside the flag. The sell broke the UHV (23:24, 133 ticks) at 1.17353, mid-flag. At 23:28-23:30 the flag broke up to the 1.1756 stop. Twins 0413-174446-S and 0413-174205-S sold the same flag 40 minutes earlier and won. The visible warning (a sell against the hour's trend in a no-trend flag) is not selective: ADX bins are flat (ADX < 17.7 is x0.73/x0.65), counter_trend60 x0.86.

Dead Asian tape at 02:55 UTC: ATR 0.51 pip, bars of 10-30 ticks. The UHV (07:40 PKT, green, 120 ticks) was the bounce off the 07:36 low (1.1756). The retracement then drifted sideways for 15 minutes, and the sell broke the UHV low at 1.17580 only at 07:55, 14 candles after the UHV (box 20). No follow-through came; price drifted up and later ran to the stop. Twin 0413-223802-S (03:38 PKT) had the same thin Asian tape and won. Stale UHVs and low-ATR Asian trades are not selective (stale_uhv x1.16/x0.76, low_atr_asia x1.32/x0.78), and the 60-bar mean volume (55 ticks) is above the dead-tape threshold.

From the 12:08 spike top (1.1796) and a 12:40 lower high (1.1792), price bled 17 pips over 50 minutes back to 1.1775, where the 11:55 rally had started. Volume faded on the way down (70-110 ticks). The UHV (13:21, 83 ticks) gave a sell at 1.17757, 0.9 pip above the 13:20 low. That is selling a tired drift into the base of the previous impulse; price bounced 9 pips to 1.1784. Twin 0414-120951-S sold the low of a collapse at 17:09 and won. Selling into old support or a fresh low is not selective (near_fresh_extreme x0.92/x0.99).

Weak case, though: once the session rules are applied, low volume adds only x1.24/x1.44.

The camel was RED only because of a 2.4-pip micro hump at 13:34-13:38 (high 1.17847, low 1.17823). The retracement, which was the rally itself, went 6.5 pips above that hump's high, so the down-structure was already broken. The sell broke the 13:45 green UHV's low at 1.17900, near the top of the 7-candle range (box 3), into higher highs; price climbed to 1.1796. Twin 0417-040531-S sold a rally only after it had topped and rolled over. The chart says skip; the data says no. Even the corrected structure test (struct_broken_colour: retracement 2+ pips beyond the colour-setting hump, read from the camel state at that hump's redraw) is x1.05/x0.79, and micro_hump_flip is x1.11/x1.63.
losses.cause: camel misread (stale red camel in a vertical rally)

The buy came off the red UHV (23:29, 139 ticks) at 1.17936, 4 pips under the rejected top, at 18:31 UTC on Friday. Price fell 20 pips into the weekly close. Twins 0417-180551-B and 0417-171505-B bought the same range earlier and won. Visible before entry: Friday after 17:00 UTC, the window where an unpaid trade has hours of thin tape and the forced 20:58 close ahead. fri_late17 x4.05/x3.87, session_close x3.80/x3.73, fri_17_19 x2.76/x2.75.

Entered at Friday 20:58 UTC, two minutes before the weekly close. The fill was 2.6 pips above the level (the closing spread was blown out), and the position was force-closed at 20:58 for -2.6 pips (-$26). The market reopened 25 pips lower (1.1738). This is not a setup failure but a close-window execution. Every close and spread rule removes it: fri_late20 x8.93/x9.41, rollover_2045_2200 x4.96/x7.34, slip_20 x6.38/x6.81.

A failed 19:43 PKT spike to 1.1776 turned into a 27-pip collapse from 19:45 to 20:03 (1.1773 to 1.1748) on the session's heaviest volume (300+ ticks). The 20:03-20:16 dead-cat bounce built two small green humps (GREEN x2). The buy broke the red UHV (20:16, 254 ticks) at 1.17597, into the 19:49-19:55 shelf (1.1758-1.1761) where the collapse had paused, now resistance. The bounce died there and price fell to 1.1741. Twin 0421-150927-B bought the same bounce 3 pips lower at 20:09 and won. A bounce camel against a big opposite leg is not selective (counter_trend60 x0.80/x1.00).

Seven minutes after the 14:00 UTC data slot, in a wide, choppy range (1.1683-1.1697, ATR 2.95 pips). Neither the time slot (13:55-14:05 UTC: x0.85 train / x1.70 test) nor range position or touches are selective.

Visible before entry: Friday after 17:00 UTC. fri_late17 x4.05/x3.87, session_close x3.80/x3.73.

85 minutes after the Sunday open, which gapped 25 pips down from Friday's 1.1722 to 1.1697. The first 30 minutes traded under 20 ticks a bar; the gap half-filled to 1.1710 by 02:55 PKT, then went flat. The sell broke a 48-tick UHV (03:24) at 1.17055, against the unfinished gap fill, on a 60-bar mean of 29 ticks. The tape kept lifting toward the gap and later reached the stop. Both twins (03:03 and 03:18) sold the same tape and won, so nothing separates this loss from its twins. The rule skips the whole dead session instead: low_vol60_30 x3.02/x2.40 stand-alone, inside liquidity_guard; sunday_open alone is only x1.18/x1.21.
losses.cause: chop/range (Sunday-open thin tape, unfinished gap fill)

losses.comment: A 19:52 PKT spike to 1.1748 collapsed 15 pips in four minutes (19:53-19:57) on 270-290 ticks a bar. The UHV is the collapse candle itself (19:56, 288 ticks, high 1.17366). def rule(t, A):
    """The fill is 1.2+ pips beyond the UHV level (buy: ask above the high = spread + jump; sell: bid below the low = jump). The 0.1-pip

rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    """session_close + the fill already 2+ pips past the level (a spike / blown spread outside the close windows)."""
    s = t["t_in"] % 86400
    fri = int((t["t_in"] // 86400 + 4) % 7) == 5
    if (fri and s >= 17 * 3600) or (20 * 3600 + 45 * 60 <= s < 22 * 3600):
        return True
    return (t["fill"] - t["level"]) * t["side"] >= 2.0 * A.PIP

rules.idea: A 100-pip round number (1.1700, 1.1800 ...) lies 0-1.0 pip beyond the UHV level in the trade direction: the take-profit (spread + 0.1 pip past the level) must pierce the big figure, where resting orders sit (loss 0408-075606-B: target exactly 1.17000).
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    """A 100-pip round number (1.1700, 1.1800 ...) lies 0-1.0 pip beyond the UHV level in the trade direction: the take-profit (spread + 0.1
    pip past the level) must pierce the big figure, where resting orders sit (loss 0408-075606-B: target exactly 1.17000)."""
    lv, s = t["level"], t["side"]
    near = round(lv / 0.01) * 0.01
    d = round((near - lv) * s / A.PIP, 1)
    return 0.0 <= d <= 1.0
rules.verdict: GOOD on paper, FRAGILE: 7 losers; train lift >= 2 only at the 1.0-pip cutoff (0.8 gives x2.18 with 5L, 1.5 gives x1.65); outside liquidity_guard x1.90 / x1.83. | api.report: train 4L/47W, test 3L/43W, WR after 97.81%, net +1,020$ at 1 lot

rules.idea: Stand aside when the 1-pip follow-through cannot be trusted: (a) Friday from 17:00 UTC (held into the weekly close), (b) every day 20:45-22:00 UTC (rollover spread blow-out), (c) the fill is already 1.5+ pips past the UHV level (wide spread / spike fill), (d) the last 60 closed candles averaged < 30 ticks (dead tape).
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    """Stand aside when the 1-pip follow-through cannot be trusted: (a) Friday from 17:00 UTC (held into the weekly close), (b) every day
    20:45-22:00 UTC (rollover spread blow-out), (c) the fill is already 1.5+ pips past the UHV level (wide spread / spike fill),
    (d) the last 60 closed candles averaged < 30 ticks (dead tape)."""
    s = t["t_in"] % 86400
    fri = int((t["t_in"] // 86400 + 4) % 7) == 5
    if (fri and s >= 17 * 3600) or (20 * 3600 + 45 * 60 <= s < 22 * 3600):
        return True
    if (t["fill"] - t["level"]) * t["side"] >= 1.5 * A.PIP:
        return True
    k = t["k"]
    return float(np.mean(A.v[k - 59:k + 1])) < 30

def rule(t, A):

def rule(t, A):
    """Selling the fresh low / buying the fresh high after a strong trend leg: ADX >= 40, the last 60 candles moved >= 3 ATR in the trade
    direction and the level sits in the bottom (sell) / top (buy) quarter of the 60-candle range (losses 0409-062811-S, 0409-110305-S,
    0413-064826-S, 0413-120919-S)."""
    k, s, lv = t["k"], t["side"], t["level"]
    atr = max(float(A.atr[k]), 1e-6)
    hi, lo = float(A.h[k - 59:k + 1].max()), float(A.l[k - 59:k + 1].min())
    pos = ((lv - lo) if s < 0 else (hi - lv)) / (hi - lo) if hi > lo else 0.5
    tr = (A.c[k] - A.c[k - 60]) * s / atr
    return A.adx[k] >= 40 and tr >= 3 and pos <= 0.25

def rule(t, A):
    """The camel's colour comes from ONE hump (camStk +-1) whose smaller leg is under 1 pip: a noise flip, not a trend (losses
    0416-045923-B, 0423-164516-B, 0414-025520-S, 0426-222526-S)."""
    k = t["k"]
    if abs(t["camStk"]) != 1:
        return False
    LV, ST = A.camLV, A.camStk
    j = k
    while j > k - 400 and LV[j] == LV[k] and ST[j] == ST[k]:
        j -= 1
    j += 1
    hv, lv, l0 = float(A.camHV[j]), float(A.camLV[j]), float(A.camL0V[j])
    return min(hv - lv, hv - l0) < 1.0 * A.PIP

def rule(t, A):
    """The retracement went beyond the hump that SET the camel colour (as the per-bar camel state showed it at that hump's last redraw,
    bar j <= k): sell - above that red hump's high; buy - below that green hump's end low. Losses 0417-084606-S (+6.5 pips) and
    0427-150215-B (+2.0). (camHV[k] itself can already be the retracement's own high, so struct_broken mis-measured the sells.)"""
    k = t["k"]
    LV, ST = A.camLV, A.camStk
    j = k
    while j > k - 400 and LV[j] == LV[k] and ST[j] == ST[k]:
        j -= 1
    j += 1
    if t["side"] < 0:
        return t["extreme"] - float(A.camHV[j]) >= 2.0 * A.PIP
    return float(A.camLV[j]) - t["extreme"] >= 2.0 * A.PIP

def rule(t, A):
    """The level was touched (within 1 pip) by 15+ of the last 30 candles' lows (sell) / highs (buy): selling a floor that keeps holding."""
    k, s, lv = t["k"], t["side"], t["level"]
    seg = A.l[k - 29:k + 1] if s < 0 else A.h[k - 29:k + 1]
    d = ((seg - lv) if s < 0 else (lv - seg)) / A.PIP
    return int(np.sum((d <= 1.0) & (d >= -1.0))) >= 15
